card.name: Linking words in neonatal opioid withdrawal text
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "an", "can" and "for" inside the stock sentence "Use of [opioid] for an extended period of time during pregnancy can result in withdrawal". It also fires on a few other small words before numbers or section references in label text.

modes.label: Neonatal withdrawal sentence
modes.description: Small words like "an" or "can" inside the opioid-in-pregnancy warning sentence.
modes.example: Use of Morphine Sulfate Oral Solution for<< an>> extended period of time during pregnancy can result

modes.label: Words before numbers or references
modes.description: A period, "to" or a space just before a number in a cross-reference or a numeric limit.

card.plain: It lights up on small connecting words in the standard warning about opioid use in pregnancy and newborn withdrawal.
